name: prose-forbids-graph-state-reads
body:
The distributed agents' File-access prose must plainly forbid direct reads of graph-state files. In each of `spec-review.md`, `spec-writer.md`, `plan-writer.md`, `plan-review.md` the `## File access (strict)` section must describe the durable spec node files and the transient plan/feedback stores (in prose, without their filesystem paths — domain.constraint.no-internals-in-prose) as things the agent must NEVER read directly, and must name the apg tools as the only interface that reaches them — restricted to the apg tools that agent itself actually holds, as granted in its own permission frontmatter, never the suite-wide union.

The rule is per-agent. Each File-access section names only the agent's own granted tools — e.g. a reviewer whose frontmatter holds read-only query/review/plan-read tools names only those; an authoring agent names only its own authoring/query tools. Naming a tool outside the agent's own grant would itself recreate the prose-exceeds-grant mismatch this requirement exists to remove (the sibling `prose-matches-read-grant` law).

Acceptance: after the change no File-access section carries an unqualified "you may read any file" claim; each states the never-read-directly rule; the interface each section names is a subset of that agent's own granted apg tools (no section names a tool the agent does not hold); and reading ordinary source files behind code FQNs with `read` remains explicitly allowed.
